name: Haliya
description: A bright, eager squire in the Sunstar Free Company who arrived on the Dawnsire and serves Syr Vondam.

timeline.summary: On the Candela, Haliya wraps Vondam in his himsary banners before battle and he tells her they go to the Dawnsire where there may be combat.
timeline.quote: We are going over to the Dawnsire today,

timeline.summary: Haliya recites the Litany of Dawn with Vondam and asks for breakfast with her friends.
timeline.quote: If it is where you want to be when you face death, Squire? Then there is time for nothing else.

timeline.summary: Haliya's bind discusses the expected Monoist suicide attack.
timeline.quote: So, they need an unreasonable way, a way that makes no sense: throw people at the problem and hope one of them manages something.

timeline.summary: CoroNet orders squires to report as phorocast predicts imminent enemy action.
timeline.quote: REPORT TO YOUR KNIGHTS. PHOROCAST PREDICTS IMMINENT ENEMY ACTION.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Haliya go to the Dawnsire's bridge and meet Captain Slats, an Astelli, who phorocasts that Vondam will die in the battle.
timeline.quote: I phorocast that you die in the battle.

timeline.summary: Haliya blurts that the prophecy might be an enemy trick, uttering the blasphemy anstruth.
timeline.quote: "Anstruth, Syr," she says.

timeline.summary: The bridge darkens red as phorocast detects an imminent impact, and Slats orders collision alarms and the deployment of knights.
timeline.quote: Garrison to repel boarders, number-two basilica!

timeline.summary: Vondam closes his helmet and tells Haliya to look to the Sum, then goes to face the attack.
timeline.quote: Look to the Sum, Squire.

timeline.summary: Squire Haliya follows Syr Vondam down the Dawnsire's spine, convinced she will die.
timeline.quote: They plunge down the Dawnsire 's spine.

timeline.summary: Haliya fears for Vondam, who is prophesied to die, and resolves to die before him.
timeline.quote: Vondam is prophesied to die.

timeline.summary: Vondam, Walker and Quinidad learn from a phonon survey that Sunstar garrison troops are fighting the boarders near the basilica.
timeline.quote: A company of the garrison has engaged boarders just abeam of the basilica.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Walker fire their bladiators through the deck to strike the Monoists below, with Haliya cleaning Vondam's beamline.
timeline.quote: The two knights plunge their bladiators into the deck and fire .

timeline.summary: The Monoists below pulse gravity waves at the deck, shaking it apart.
timeline.quote: The deck whines under their boots.

timeline.summary: The deck collapses under Haliya.
timeline.quote: The deck goes out from under her.

timeline.summary: As she falls, Haliya broadcasts all her power to protect Vondam.
timeline.quote: She throws her arms out to her knight and broadcasts every bit of power she can.

timeline.summary: Haliya blasts her way out of a flooded bathhouse tank with a bladiator steam jet.
timeline.quote: The steam jet cuts through the soft wall of the water tank, and the boiling water blasts her out like a cork into the bathhouse floor.

timeline.summary: Haliya fires at a Monoist fanatic gliding toward her.
timeline.quote: Haliya snaps her bladiator up and fires.

timeline.summary: In the bathhouse Alpharael is shot by a seemingly dead Summist, who is Haliya.
timeline.quote: The dead Summist shoots him.

timeline.summary: Alpharael's tidal attack backfires and hits his own armor.
timeline.quote: He has shot himself in the face.

timeline.summary: A Monoist fanatic seizes Haliya's helmet and concusses her at ninety-five gravities.
timeline.quote: The concussion blanks her.

timeline.summary: Alpharael, thinking of his lost sister, pins Haliya and attacks her head.
timeline.quote: So Alpharael bears down on the fallen Summist and rattles her brain in her skull like a bruised pomegranate.

timeline.summary: Haliya's blade splits Alpharael open and his armor fails, and a Sunstar knight's beam throws him into a corner.
timeline.quote: The Summist's blade splits him open.

timeline.summary: Vondam arrives, drives Alpharael off Haliya, and orders a concussion drill.
timeline.quote: Haliya! Concussion drill!

timeline.summary: Vondam kills the main enemy, apparently Simma, and Haliya fights to hold Alpharael back.
timeline.quote: Vondam has killed the main enemy.

timeline.summary: Haliya despairs over Vondam's apparent death and her failure to save him.
timeline.quote: The Haliya who wasn't quick, or strong, or sure enough to save her knight, the Haliya who allowed a pathetic fallen foe to throw his suicide through Vondam's skull .

timeline.summary: Vondam is revealed alive, with a pinhead hole through his head.
timeline.quote: He shows Haliya the hole in his helmet, then the hole in his face, just to the left of his nose.

timeline.summary: Haliya reveals that Captain Slats let Alpharael escape in a Hopelight.
timeline.quote: "Captain Slats let him."

timeline.summary: Vondam suspects the event of his survival was engineered and that he is an anstruth.
timeline.quote: I am also an anstruth.

timeline.summary: Vondam concludes some force wants Alpharael alive.
timeline.quote: I'm saying that something wants that Monoist alive.

timeline.summary: Vondam vows that he and Haliya will pursue Alpharael once healed.
timeline.quote: But once we're fit again, we're going after him.

timeline.summary: Haliya, aboard the Sundog, stares guiltily at the hole in Vondam's skull and thinks of Alpharael.
timeline.quote: Haliya catches herself staring at the hole in Syr Vondam's skull again.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Haliya left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.
timeline.quote: They left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.

timeline.summary: Vondam says they are going to find and kill Alpharael, not for revenge.
timeline.quote: All he will say is that they are going to find and kill Alpharael.

timeline.summary: Vondam gives Haliya a quartz crystal containing the anathalmanac.
timeline.quote: He gives her a quartz memory crystal.

timeline.summary: Vondam explains his belief that an anathema object in Sothera is calling for a wielder and threatens the Sunstar mission.
timeline.quote: I believe one such object is in Sothera.

timeline.summary: Haliya reads protocol seven, radiant resignation, requiring destruction of everything the object touches.
timeline.quote: 7. Radiant resignation. Destroy yourself, all those about you, and the Object, by the most immediate and violent means available.

timeline.summary: Vondam declares that his judgment cannot be trusted and Haliya is now effectively the knight.
timeline.quote: In a sense, Haliya, you are now the knight and I the squire.

timeline.summary: Vondam asks Haliya whether she could order the destruction of all Taro-duend if needed.
timeline.quote: Can you destroy it all?

timeline.summary: Haliya refuses to help kill a settlement of innocents.
timeline.quote: I won't do it. I'm not going to kill a settlement full of defenseless innocents.

timeline.summary: Haliya proposes to go down to Taro-duend herself to find and kill Alpharael.
timeline.quote: You don't go down there. I do.

timeline.summary: Haliya persuades Vondam to let her go in his place by invoking a knight's trust.
timeline.quote: He would give her a chance to be worthy of his trust.

timeline.summary: Haliya makes her first combat descent to Taro-duend alone.
timeline.quote: A team of photophoroi from the Moratorio Cosmogrand help her make her first combat descent.

timeline.summary: Haliya builds a triple-jointed pendulum to shield herself from the object by tying her actions to scripture.
timeline.quote: 3. Pendulum, encoding faith. Fashion from gleanings a triple-jointed pendulum. Dangle it from thy armor.

timeline.summary: In the third cave she checks, Haliya finds the Seriema.
timeline.quote: In the third cave she checks, she finds a ship called the Seriema

timeline.summary: Haliya plants charges on the Seriema before going in.
timeline.quote: Plant a charge under the Seriema 's folded airfoil.

timeline.summary: Haliya enters the cargo bay and Alpharael tries to banish her with the stone.
timeline.quote: Alpharael brandishes the rock at her and shouts, "Vanish!"

timeline.summary: Haliya stuns Alpharael with her bladiator.
timeline.quote: The bright figure shoots him.

timeline.summary: Haliya puts a dead-man bomb in Alpharael's mouth to protect herself from the object's influence.
timeline.quote: That's a bomb," she says. "If it doesn't get my passcode every ten seconds, it'll blow up.

timeline.summary: Haliya asks Alpharael to use the object to change the past so she was the one he killed, sparing Vondam.
timeline.quote: I need you to change things so that I was the one you killed

timeline.summary: Haliya urges Alpharael to change the past.
timeline.quote: "Do it," she urges him.

timeline.summary: Haliya tells Vondam she has Alpharael and offers to be the one the object changed.
timeline.quote: I can be the one it changed. You can be yourself again.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders Haliya to kill Alpharael and return with the object.
timeline.quote: Haliya, I am ordering you to kill him and return with the object.

timeline.summary: Haliya tells Vondam to proceed with protocol seven and fire on her, the object and the Kav.
timeline.quote: You have to fire. Destroy me, the object, and the Kav.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders Haliya to get out and move to the slag field for extraction.
timeline.quote: Move to the slag field for extraction.

timeline.summary: As a human and a Kav, apparently Sami and Tannuk, reach the Seriema's ramp, Haliya shoots the human through the heart.
timeline.quote: She lases the human through the heart.

timeline.summary: Haliya kills the grieving Kav, apparently Tannuk, with her bladiator.
timeline.quote: It takes a surprisingly long fraction of a second for her bladiator to burn through the Kav's throat and kill it, too.

timeline.summary: Alpharael jabs himself with a jet injector and the injection passes through the hole in his hand and into Haliya, paralyzing her.
timeline.quote: Only the injection has gone through his hand, through her armor, and into her .

timeline.summary: Sami finds Alpharael huddled at the feet of the frozen Sunstar armor, holding the stone and the injector.
timeline.quote: a suit of golden armor standing, frozen, over Alpharael, who is huddled wretchedly around its ankles

timeline.summary: Vondam announces to all units that they are going to protocol seven and have two minutes.
timeline.quote: We are going to protocol seven. You have two minutes.

timeline.summary: Haliya appears in the cockpit and offers herself as a hostage.
timeline.quote: "Looking for a hostage?" Haliya says.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Haliya's armor frees her from the paralytic, and she shocks Alpharael's hands and makes him put the stone in stasis.
timeline.quote: She fries his left hand, too, so he drops the object.

timeline.summary: Haliya demands the ship land and puts herself on the distress frequency so Vondam will hear.
timeline.quote: Land this ship. Put me on one-forty-two.

timeline.summary: Haliya radios Vondam, claiming she has the object and urging him to stop killing the Kav.
timeline.quote: Syr Vondam. Syr Vondam, this is Squire Haliya.

timeline.summary: Vondam tells Haliya to kill the crew and force the ship down.
timeline.quote: We'll keep pace until you can kill the crew and force it down.

timeline.summary: Haliya urges Vondam to order her death as protocol seven requires.
timeline.quote: We traded places. Now you must order mine!

timeline.summary: Vondam refuses to destroy the ship, wanting the object retrieved in stasis.
timeline.quote: We'll retrieve the object and return it to Candela in stasis.

timeline.summary: Haliya begs Vondam to kill her too if the object is worth so much.
timeline.quote: Syr, kill me. If this object is worth so much.

timeline.summary: Sami takes Vondam's silence as permission to escape.
timeline.quote: May I take this as your permission to make my escape?

timeline.summary: Sami declares Alpharael and Haliya guests under mallowmass to stop them fighting.
timeline.quote: Captain Sami declares that all their new passengers are guests under the protection of mallowmass.

timeline.summary: Haliya reflects that she can never be a Sunstar knight after the atrocity and her desertion.
timeline.quote: She will never be a Sunstar knight of the Free Company.

timeline.summary: Sami learns that the Dawnsire carries a weapon to turn Sothera back into a sun.
timeline.quote: Wait. Undo sekhar? Are you talking about turning Sothera back into a real sun?

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael explain to Sami how they came to Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Together the two of them explain to Captain Sami how they came to Kavaron.

timeline.summary: Haliya argues that the Sunstar, not Alpharael, bear responsibility for the dead Kav.
timeline.quote: He's not responsible for the dead Kav at Taro-duend, either. We are.

timeline.summary: Haliya concludes that Vondam obeyed the Sum but that the massacre was nonetheless wrong.
timeline.quote: But it was wrong. I know it.

timeline.summary: Haliya decides the object must be destroyed, and Sami objects.
timeline.quote: We need to destroy the object. It poisons everything.

timeline.summary: Sami reveals they are looking for their lost cat Mirri.
timeline.quote: I look for my cat.

timeline.summary: Haliya offers to help look for the cat.
timeline.quote: I'll help you look for the cat,

timeline.summary: Sami insists the stone will be given to the Metalman rather than destroyed.
timeline.quote: We're giving it to the Metalman.

timeline.summary: Sami tells them the Metalman is a wizard.
timeline.quote: I told you. He's a wizard .

timeline.summary: Haliya takes a defensive position and resolves to stop Alpharael from taking the ship or using the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Her goal is to prevent Alpharael from taking the ship or using the object.

timeline.summary: Haliya rejects destroying the rock because it would violate mallowmass.
timeline.quote: But that would violate mallowmass.

timeline.summary: Haliya summons Alpharael to meet with her.
timeline.quote: Eventually, the Summist calls Alpharael to meet with her.

timeline.summary: Haliya proposes a détente with Alpharael.
timeline.quote: "We must reach an accord," she says.

timeline.summary: Haliya says the Sum told her to kill everyone aboard and herself, but she did not.
timeline.quote: Only the Sum says that I was supposed to kill everyone on this ship, including myself.

timeline.summary: Haliya calls Alpharael an apostate and offers to take up his case.
timeline.quote: "So, you're an apostate," she says happily.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she will argue that Slats rightly granted Alpharael mercy.
timeline.quote: I'll beg your pardon, and that means I have no duty to kill you.

timeline.summary: Haliya takes off her helmet and says the Free Company's armor is no longer hers.
timeline.quote: Haliya takes her helmet off, moving so sharply that Alpharael flinches away.

timeline.summary: Alpharael gives Haliya a bottle of cleaning solute.
timeline.quote: I got you a present, by the way.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret questions Haliya about her armor.
timeline.quote: "You wear a wealth of metal," he says.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret laughs at Haliya's objection to counterfeit memories.
timeline.quote: Listen to her! Counterfeit memories, an atrocity.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she cannot let Tezzeret take the object.
timeline.quote: "I can't let you take the object," Haliya says.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret silently forces Haliya's armor to close on her.
timeline.quote: her armor ripples like porridge and closes on her.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret releases Haliya, who drifts limp, and moves to consult the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Haliya drifts away spinning, limbs limp.

timeline.summary: Vondam predicts his former student will come to Infinite Guideline to steal an eternity drive.
timeline.quote: Infinite Guideline has an eternity column, and it is the only place in the system with eternity drive ferries that can lift her ship into warp.

timeline.summary: Alpharael says he wants to use the stone so his sister never took the Plummet.
timeline.quote: I want to use it so that my sister never took the Plummet.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret admits he is saving his own ship in case he must abandon the others.
timeline.quote: You're saving it in case you need to abandon the rest of us to die.

timeline.summary: Sami threatens to blow up the ship rather than let Tezzeret harm Haliya, invoking mallowmass.
timeline.quote: "I will detonate this ship if I have to," Sami says.

timeline.summary: Sami lays out a plan for Haliya and Alpharael to steal a warp ferry from Infinite Guideline's docking arms.
timeline.quote: Haliya and Alpharael will use armor to leap from the Seriema to one of the harbormaster modules at the end of Infinite Guideline's docking arms.

timeline.summary: Haliya agrees to send the message, saying she will carry out her duty to report to Vondam and beg pardon for Alpharael.
timeline.quote: All I can do is carry out my next duty. To return to Vondam, make my report, and beg pardon for Alpharael.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she will not become someone who kills innocents in their homes.
timeline.quote: I don't want to be someone who kills innocents in their homes.

timeline.summary: A narrator describes alternate branches for where the crystal might point, rejects each, and says to go back and choose better.
timeline.quote: Go back and make a better choice.

timeline.summary: Haliya reluctantly aligns her Sunstar frequency-hopper so the Seriema can listen to Free Company traffic.
timeline.quote: It takes some verbal fencing before Haliya is willing to align her Sunstar Company frequency-hopper with the Seriema 's receiver.

timeline.summary: The crew watches a distant space battle in which a ship is hit.
timeline.quote: Someone was hit, and died, or lived.

timeline.summary: Haliya agonizes over broadcasting and reveals she planted two bombs on the ship.
timeline.quote: I have two bombs on the ship,

timeline.summary: Alpharael persuades Haliya to keep her word and make the broadcast.
timeline.quote: Maybe you aren't cut out to be a Sunstar knight, Haliya. Maybe you aren't cut out to be certain of everything.

timeline.summary: Tannuk reveals the crew had already found and thrown out Haliya's bombs.
timeline.quote: We found them while the Illvoi were refitting the fusion engine and threw them out.

timeline.summary: Haliya broadcasts to the Free Company that she has detached from Vondam's command and offers the artifact on Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: I have detached myself from Syr Vondam's command and placed myself on errantry.

timeline.summary: Sami says their plan with Pinnacle is to tell the whole truth.
timeline.quote: So, I'm going to tell them the truth. All of it.

timeline.summary: Sami reveals they were kitchen help on the Wurm Speaker, which went to the voices in the Wurmwall and mostly did not return.
timeline.quote: I was kitchen help. Not a lot of people came back.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael, drifting toward the tug quay in armor, find the warp ferries are gone.
timeline.quote: I don't want to declare defeat too soon. But the ferries are gone.

timeline.summary: Infinite Guideline springs leaks and loses its aurorae as Monoist mechans dock at punctures.
timeline.quote: Infinite Guideline has just sprung leaks. A lot of leaks.

timeline.summary: Haliya spots a many-limbed shape headed for the dock where the Seriema is moored.
timeline.quote: It has a lot of limbs.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael crash into the tug quay and enter the station.
timeline.quote: They crash into the tug quay and stick.

timeline.summary: Alpharael recites random numbers hoping the Endstone will make his guess a correct ferry code, and it is rejected.
timeline.quote: You thought you'd guess randomly, then, in the future, you'd get the Endstone and make your guess correct!

timeline.summary: Haliya insists on returning to the Free Company to report and beg Alpharael's pardon.
timeline.quote: I'm going to make my report and beg your pardon.

timeline.summary: Vondam appears on the control deck and says he acted in accordance with the Sum except when he let Haliya go out of love.
timeline.quote: I did act in accordance with the Sum. Except when I let you go. I did that out of love.

timeline.summary: Vondam, helmet open and bladiators ready, stands between them and the airlock.
timeline.quote: He is here. Standing on the far side of the control deck. Between them and the airlock.

timeline.summary: Vondam calls on Haliya to come home and take the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Come home, Haliya.

timeline.summary: Vondam tells Haliya he should have killed her when she begged him to and urges her to live with failure.
timeline.quote: I should've killed you when you begged me to.

timeline.summary: Vondam pleads with Haliya to return to the faith.
timeline.quote: "Come back," he pleads.

timeline.summary: Haliya refuses to return home with the stone as a hero and explains the Sum must account for her revolt.
timeline.quote: I will not go home with the stone and be a hero.

timeline.summary: Haliya drives Vondam off Alpharael with her bladiator.
timeline.quote: She thrusts her long-handled bladiator from the hip and drives Syr Vondam off.

timeline.summary: Vondam formally degrades Haliya and bars her from knighthood.
timeline.quote: by my authority as a knight of the company, I hereby degrade you.

timeline.summary: Haliya is cast out of the Free Company and chooses to believe her choice was right.
timeline.quote: He has cast her out of the Free Company.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Vondam fight a sparring-style duel on the control deck.
timeline.quote: "Tally-ho," Vondam says, mildly.

timeline.summary: Vondam says protocol dictated the slaughter, convincing Haliya that the fault lies in the Sum.
timeline.quote: I had to. Protocol dictated it.

timeline.summary: Haliya concludes the fault is not in Vondam or herself but in the Sum.
timeline.quote: The fault is not in him, or in her. It is in the Sum.

timeline.summary: Haliya embraces Vondam and, using the hole in Alpharael's hand, jabs her thumb into the back of his neck.
timeline.quote: Haliya embraces him and jabs her right thumb into the hole in Alpharael's hand.

timeline.summary: Haliya pops apart Vondam's vertebrae.
timeline.quote: She digs her thumb into his vertebrae and pops them apart.

timeline.summary: Haliya cuts Vondam's nerve interface, leaving him helpless.
timeline.quote: But his squire reaches through the hole in her enemy's hand and cuts her knight's nerve interface away.

timeline.summary: Haliya makes her report to Vondam and asks pardon for Alpharael.
timeline.quote: I have made my report,

timeline.summary: Vondam demands that Haliya kill him but she cannot do what the Sum asks.
timeline.quote: She cannot do what the Sum asks.

timeline.summary: Haliya places herself on errantry, still a Summist but cast out of the Free Company.
timeline.quote: I've been cast out of the Free Company, but I am still a Summist. I place myself on errantry.

timeline.summary: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under warship scrutiny.
timeline.quote: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under the terrifying scrutiny of warships.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she cannot believe Alpharael guessed the ferry code.
timeline.quote: I still can't believe you guessed that code,

timeline.summary: Alpharael realizes a cherazad has frozen the battle.
timeline.quote: "Tactical event horizon," he realizes.

timeline.summary: Sami learns the warp ferry is in a cherazad and the fleet will kill them as they prepare to warp.
timeline.quote: We can't leave the bubble! The Free Company fleet will kill us the moment we prepare to warp.

timeline.summary: Solar Knights board from the dock.
timeline.quote: "Solar Knights outside!" Haliya calls.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret toasts the success of taking a piece of the unknown.
timeline.quote: We have taken a piece of the unknown.

timeline.summary: Haliya's bladiator cuts two of the visitor's fingers and the visitor crushes her throat.
timeline.quote: Haliya's blade goes through two of its fingers.

timeline.summary: Haliya traveled to Sothera aboard the Dawnsire, which will reignite the supervoid.
timeline.quote: She traveled there aboard the Dawnsire , a horizon javelin and kilometers-long vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid—something the system's Monoists will do anything to prevent.

timeline.summary: Haliya pledged her bladiator to Syr Vondam's service.
timeline.quote: Haliya has pledged her bladiator to the service of Syr Vondam, her mentor and idol who has trained her since she was a young woman.

relations.quote: It is her duty as a squire and aspirant.
The most promising pupil Vondam has ever taught.

relations.note: a squire of the Free Company
relations.quote: They all came to the Free Company together

relations.note: Haliya blames Alpharael for Vondam's wound.
relations.quote: She let the coward Alpharael throw a black hole through her knight's skull.

relations.note: Quinidad taught Haliya to see in battle.
relations.quote: little Quinidad who taught Haliya how to see in battle

relations.note: Vondam describes his squire as a student, a Solar Knight in training.
Haliya is Vondam's squire, though she has detached from his command.
relations.quote: This is Haliya, squire to Syr Vondam of the Candela .

relations.note: Haliya says she needs someone to protect.
relations.quote: I need somebody to protect, or I don't know what to do.

relations.note: Haliya was Vondam's squire before being cast out.
relations.quote: You're the best squire I ever had.

relations.note: Haliya's mentor and idol who trained her.
relations.quote: Haliya has pledged her bladiator to the service of Syr Vondam, her mentor and idol who has trained her since she was a young woman.

relations.note: Haliya pledged her bladiator to Vondam.
relations.quote: Haliya has pledged her bladiator to the service of Syr Vondam, her mentor and idol who has trained her since she was a young woman.

relations.note: Haliya is a squire in the company.
relations.quote: Haliya is a bright and eager squire in the Sunstar Free Company.

pages_say.description: A Solar Knight squire of the Sunstar Free Company who serves Syr Vondam and questions the Sum.
A squire of the Sunstar Free Company who serves Syr Vondam, wields a bladiator, and has a gift she can broadcast to protect her knight.
Syr Vondam's squire in the Sunstar Free Company, who goes alone into Taro-duend to stop Alpharael, refuses to order a massacre, and is ultimately felled by Alpharael.
A Sunstar squire who is shocked by Taro-duend's massacre, begs Vondam to kill her, and is left aboard the Seriema, doubting the Sum.
A Sunstar squire adrift on the Seriema who questions the Sum after Taro-duend, is overpowered by Tezzeret, and agrees to send a message to the Free Company as part of Sami's plan.
A Sunstar squire who broadcasts to the Free Company that she has detached from Vondam's command, then helps Alpharael try to steal a ferry and meets Vondam again.
A Sunstar squire who refuses to return to the faith, is cast out of the Free Company by Vondam, defeats him with Alpharael's help, and is crushed by the Endstone's visitor.
A bright, eager squire in the Sunstar Free Company who arrived on the Dawnsire and serves Syr Vondam.
